question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
  SELECT 
    m.season,
    l.name AS league_name,
    c.name AS country_name,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    m.season,
    l.name AS league_name,
    c.name AS country_name,
    m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match m
  JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
),
team_season_points AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    team_api_id,
    SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM match_points
  GROUP BY season, league_name, country_name, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    team_api_id,
    total_points,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_name ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
  FROM team_season_points
)
SELECT 
  rt.season,
  t.team_long_name AS team_name,
  rt.league_name AS league,
  rt.country_name AS country,
  CAST(rt.total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points
FROM ranked_teams rt
JOIN Team t ON rt.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE rt.rn = 1
ORDER BY rt.season, rt.league_name
